dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-to-posterior region features multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored rings. The perimeters exhibit high-frequency, jagged edge geometry with a sharp tonal gradient transitioning from high-intensity white/grey outer borders to low-intensity dark grey/black interiors. One prominent closed annulus is visible in the lower-central region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Spatial density of light-colored solid pixel clusters is highest in the posterior section, appearing as localized, amorphous spots. A lower density of larger, high-intensity patches is observed along the dorsal ridge, lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the central body region form a wide-angle scalene triangle. A secondary series of four high-intensity blobs forms a curved linear chain along the lower lateral boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, elongated, winding high-contrast white line (vermicular pattern) runs longitudinally from the anterior towards the mid-body, featuring a distinct bifurcation near the mid-dorsal region.
